scope: WinUI3 torrent properties FUNCTIONALITY, not label-only redesign
method: Independent read-only functionality design from current local WinUI/qB source and native WinApp find-ui scenarios. No production edits/build/GUI.

native_authority.decision: Keep data-bound native TreeView and existing command owners; MenuFlyout is smaller for these textual context commands than adding another CommandBarFlyout toolbar layer.

grade_scale.basis: Subjective source-based value, not live validation or measured performance
grade_scale.bloat: Higher is worse: extra controls/state/implementation/runtime burden

already_done: Tracker plain outcome and truthful relative next
Clean General read-first focus; tracker table focus; dirty editor preserved
Speed actual elapsed x and explicit gap segments

candidates.title: Native file context menu sharing existing commands
candidates.native_interaction: One MenuFlyout: Open/Folder when local, Download/Skip, Priority submenu, Rename, Copy. Reuse existing toolbar handlers and SelectedPaths packet; no second command implementation.
candidates.focus_state: Shift+F10/Menu opens on current row; right-click preserves selected packet when invoked inside it, targets invoked unselected row otherwise. Close returns to same row. Existing editor Ctrl+C unaffected.
acceptance: Toolbar/menu invoke identical SelectedPaths and ChangeFiles behavior
Folder selection normalizes descendants once
Unselected right-click acts on clicked row, not stale selection
No RPC when menu closes without command
Native selection gestures retained
candidates.cost: Adds only native menu objects and command wiring; no dependency/runtime service. Instantiate on demand; avoid persistent per-row flyouts.

candidates.title: Open selected local file through one Windows command
candidates.native_interaction: Open command in file menu and toolbar overflow; Enter on selected file invokes same owner. Use platform file association only for exactly one existing local target.
candidates.focus_state: Enter in Search still focuses tree; text editors retain Enter semantics. Local selected file required; remote target never interpreted as local path. No silent opening of absent or renamed-incomplete target.
acceptance: One local selected existing file opens exact target
No-selection/multi-selection/remote commands unavailable
Selected folder Enter opens existing local folder or retains defined native tree behavior consistently
No mutation/RPC needed to launch local target
Errors use existing ErrorBar
candidates.cost: One native shell launch path, existing file/index/name data; no new opener service/dependency. Actual path handling must account for backend incomplete names before enabling file Open.

evidence.note: Current Enter only moves search focus

candidates.title: Reveal selected file in its local containing folder
candidates.native_interaction: Folder command beside Open in file MenuFlyout; selected file reveals its containing folder, selected folder opens that folder. Root torrent Folder already exists in General; this command is specific to selected path.
candidates.focus_state: Keyboard Menu then Folder; same selected-row focus return; local-only with known directory. No extra always-visible button unless necessary.
acceptance: Nested file goes to its directory instead of torrent root
Known existing containing directory remains usable even if file not yet created
Remote location cannot launch Windows Explorer against remote server filesystem string
candidates.cost: Reuse one local shell owner with target distinction; no polling, dependency or path cache.

tracker_editor_design_gate.comparison: A raw-editor shortcuts: lower patch cost but users still manage URL lines and blank-line tiers; ergonomics 2/5. B native staged list: medium cost, clear selected-row Add/Edit/Remove; ergonomics 5/5. Choose B replacing A.
tracker_editor_design_gate.authority: One canonical ordered tier-group/URL-entry draft initialized once from TrackerList. Raw text is load/save serialization only, never another editable or cached draft. Existing _edit save/cancel/dirty transitions remain.
tracker_editor_design_gate.layout: Reuse editor region: native staged ListView, one selected URL TextBox, Add/Remove, native tier ComboBox, existing Save/Cancel. No new modal/tab/card or surface help.
tracker_editor_design_gate.tier_identity: Ordered raw groups define tier identity; runtime TrackerStat IDs, display sort and ordinal do not. Duplicate URLs are separate entries. Target exact tier/URL/occurrence only when provable, otherwise enter draft without guessing. Remove empty groups canonically; preserve order and serialize blank-line boundaries once.
tracker_editor_design_gate.keyboard: F2 enters selected URL; Add creates empty entry in selected tier and focuses URL. Delete removes only with draft list focus; TextBox Delete stays native. Arrows navigate rows, Ctrl+S existing Save, Escape existing resolution. Cancel returns status row. No per-row editable control/tab stops.
tracker_editor_design_gate.state: Selected draft entry owns all in-progress text including invalid values. Row switch preserves text without RPC. Refresh never overwrites draft. Save validates every entry and serializes once; error retains draft; clean exit has no mutation.
acceptance: No parallel raw editor or independent URL text cache
Unedited tier groups and duplicate occurrences round-trip exactly
Add supports empty list and last removal uses backend-valid empty list
Invalid input remains editable and prevents Save through existing error path
No synthetic discovery or backup status row guessed as draft entry
No RPC before Save; one whole TrackerList request
Refresh cannot overwrite staged edits
tracker_editor_design_gate.cost: Medium effort justified by ordinary task completion. Small private domain draft, one parser/serializer, existing save owner; no generic framework/dependency. Allocated only while editing.
